findings.title: listUsers validates the page before the tenant check, unlike getUser and the design order
findings.detail: design.md says listUsers does the tenant check first, then validates limit and after. src/identity/users.ts does the opposite: it validates limit and after before calling assertTenantMatches. As a result, a mismatched transaction with a bad page reports IDENTITY_INVALID, not IDENTITY_TENANT_MISMATCH. getUser does the tenant check first.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN listUsers runs with ctx a inside withTenantTx(db.appPool, b, ...) with page { limit: 0 } THEN it rejects with IDENTITY_INVALID, not IDENTITY_TENANT_MISMATCH.

findings.title: createServiceAccount refuses a padded displayName whose untrimmed length exceeds 200
findings.detail: The design says displayName is trimmed, then checked for 1 to 200 code units. The code checks the untrimmed length first (`input.displayName.length > 200`), so 199 x followed by two spaces is refused although its trimmed form is valid.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN createServiceAccount gets a displayName of 199 x followed by two spaces THEN it rejects with IDENTITY_INVALID.

findings.title: getUser checks the tenant before validating the id
findings.detail: getUser runs assertTenantMatches before it validates the id pattern. In a mismatched transaction, an id such as "a/b" therefore gives IDENTITY_TENANT_MISMATCH. No scenario pins this order down.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN getUser runs with ctx a inside withTenantTx(db.appPool, b, ...) with userId "a/b" THEN it rejects with IDENTITY_TENANT_MISMATCH.

findings.title: task 1.1: route tests do not use assert.throws
findings.detail: Task 1.1 says every rejection is checked with `assert.throws(fn, { name: "IdentityError", code, message })`. route.test.ts instead uses a custom `caught()` helper compared with assert.deepEqual. The checks are equivalent, but the stated form is not used.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace expectIdentity with assert.throws(fn, { name: "IdentityError", code, message }).

findings.title: listUsers validates the page before the tenant check, unlike getUser and the design order
findings.detail: design.md says listUsers does the tenant check first, then validates limit and after. src/identity/users.ts does the opposite: it validates limit and after before calling assertTenantMatches. As a result, a mismatched transaction with a bad page reports IDENTITY_INVALID, not IDENTITY_TENANT_MISMATCH. getUser does the tenant check first.
evidence: src/identity/users.ts: listUsers runs `if (!Number.isInteger(limit) ...) throw identityError("IDENTITY_INVALID")` before `await assertTenantMatches(tx, ctx)`
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN listUsers runs with ctx a inside withTenantTx(db.appPool, b, ...) with page { limit: 0 } THEN it rejects with IDENTITY_INVALID, not IDENTITY_TENANT_MISMATCH.

findings.title: createServiceAccount refuses a padded displayName whose untrimmed length exceeds 200
findings.detail: The design says displayName is trimmed, then checked for 1 to 200 code units. The code checks the untrimmed length first (`input.displayName.length > 200`), so 199 x followed by two spaces is refused although its trimmed form is valid.
evidence: src/identity/users.ts: `typeof input.displayName !== "string" || input.displayName.length > 200 ||` runs before `const displayName = input.displayName.trim();`
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN createServiceAccount gets a displayName of 199 x followed by two spaces THEN it rejects with IDENTITY_INVALID.

findings.title: getUser checks the tenant before validating the id

findings.suggested_fix: Replace expectIdentity with assert.throws(fn, { name: "IdentityError", code, message }).

findings.title: Stale 'Signature stub' header left in implemented files
findings.detail: errors.ts, route.ts and text.ts dropped the scaffold header comment, but tenant-idp.ts and users.ts still say they are signature stubs the owning change will implement, though they are now implemented.
evidence: src/identity/tenant-idp.ts line 1: `// Signature stub (milestone scaffold, docs/decisions/0002): the change that owns this file implements it.`
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the stub header from tenant-idp.ts and users.ts.
